title: Bump-Friedberg type periods beyond the cuspidal spectrum
summary: In this article, we study several Bump--Friedberg type periods beyond the cuspidal spectrum. We first consider the twisted Bump--Friedberg period on $\textnormal{GL}_{2n}$, as well as a variant on $\textnormal{GL}_1\times \textnormal{GL}_{2n}$. Under suitable regularity conditions on the cuspidal datum, these periods extend continuously to automorphic functions of uniform moderate growth.
